result.summary: Executed the frozen L3 protocol (PARI/GP only, no Rust, no repo crates built; 2.2 MB on disk, no target/). All 9 sizes k=8..16 (6 curves x 4 instances = 24 per size; 216 instances, 1080 instance-arm runs) and all five controls completed; code was frozen by sha256 before the run and is unchanged. Headline: no Jacobian index-calculus arm beat the matched negation-map rho at any size or any native-work price (0/0.1/1 GAE), so F1 did not fire. At w=0 the IC-D/R_E cost ratio grows 1.127 (k=8) to 20.414 (k=16); IC-G 1.369 to 41.440; IC-S 1.413 to 176.056; at w=1 IC-D/R_E is 2.805 to 149.993. All 27 IC-arm/size cells rank above R_E by the 5a rule; rho inside the Jacobian (R_J) is unresolved against R_E at every size (0.953 to 1.044), so the transfer alone gains nothing. Group-law and transfer checks: 0 failures (#C'(Fq)=q+1 on 54/54 curves, N*D=0 on 432, explicit-vs-Cantor 0/18036, T hom 0/1618, 648/648 IC solves verified). Preregistered misses and scope limits, all reported not edited: H4 slope of IC-D/R_E for k>=10 is 0.604 [0.579,0.628] vs band [0.35,0.60], and H4 point values (>=5 at k=8, >=30 at k=16) were 1.127 and 20.414, because the counted rho is 96% table construction at these sizes; the F2 R_E steps slope (0.297 [0.224,0.367]) fires 'baseline broken' (post hoc: steps scale with l not q, cofactor scatter, tiny-l walk traps at small k); PC-B passes pooled (423/432) but R_E/R_J at k=8 are 20/24 and 21/24; PC-C FAILED at k=10 and 12 (IC-D/plain upper CI >= 1 at w=1), so per the preregistration the negative ranking is scoped to raw counts and exponents; NC-A H5 not confirmed (pooled glued/random 1.034 [0.958,1.118], post hoc). The independent Haiku replication and Sonnet adversarial reviews (VERIFICATION.json) were NOT done (no subagent tool available to this run); instead a same-code same-seed reduced run reproduced all 20 raw files for k=8..12 and controls at k=8,10 exactly (wall field excluded). No improvement over the IC baseline is claimed; wall times are secondary and contention-affected. Files in research/twist_ecdlp_followup_20261107/L3-genus2-measured-arm/: RESULTS.md, results.json, DEVIATIONS.md, run.sh, out/summary.txt, out/posthoc.txt, results_plot.png/svg.

issues: Reproduced independently in my own gp from the raw out/main_k*_h*.txt files: R_E cost 1603/1640/1975 and IC-D cost 32719/59146/296265 at k=16; IC-D/R_E 1.127 (k=8), 2.962 (k=12), 20.414 (k=16) at w=0 and 2.805, 18.698, 149.993 at w=1; IC-G/R_E 1.369 and 41.440; IC-S/R_E 1.413 and 176.056; R_J/R_E 0.953 to 1.044; log-log slopes 0.604 (IC-D/R_E, k>=10), 0.297 (R_E steps) and 0.967 (T_D); rho walk ops 66.7 at k=16; non-walk share of R_E 95.6% to 97.2%; Cantor-fallback share 0.145% of IC Jops. Every one matches the report exactly. The native-work formulas in analyze.gp match the preregistered lists. kappa_J follows from the counted 28M+5S+2I and 2.0M+1.6S+1.0I (3.91 at I/M=10).

Independent mathematical check of all 54 curves, using PARI ellcard and hyperellcharpoly: #E, #E', the largest prime l and cofactor h all agree. The quintic C' is squarefree. The L-polynomial of C' equals (x^2 - t x + q)(x^2 + t x + q) exactly, so #Jac = #E * #E' and the (2,2)-gluing to the twist is genuine. l does not divide #E', so the l-Sylow subgroup of Jac is cyclic of order l, which makes the l-part projection that kills the cofactor term R in the IC relations valid. I also re-derived the relation row sum e_i L(x_i) - b X = a, the sign handling, the Mumford reduction formulas (jredu) and the explicit add/double structure by hand. I found no formula error. The 648/648 IC solves are confirmed by PARI ellmul on E, which is independent of the harness code.

The label 'prediction_confirmed' is stronger than the evidence. The report's own Table 14 lists the following as MISS or failed: H4 slope (0.604 against a band of [0.35, 0.60]) and the H4 point values; F2 for R_E steps ('baseline broken'); PC-B rho solve rate at k=8 (20/24 and 21/24); PC-C at k=10 and 12; H5 not confirmed. Preregistered F4 says a failed PC-B invalidates the instrument and allows no ranking claim. The report instead switches to a pooled reading (423/432). That pooled reading is not recorded in DEVIATIONS.md, yet it supports the '27/27 cells rank above R_E' statement. Taken together with the PC-C failure and the broken-baseline flag, the 5a ranking should be presented as raw counts and exponents only. The raw ratios are still above 1 at every size and w, so the conclusion 'no IC arm beat rho' survives.

The k=8 IC-D/R_E ranking is marginal. At w=0 the CI is [1.001, 1.265], and the bootstrap rests on only 6 curves. R_E has 4 unsolved runs at k=8, and their cost is the cap, i.e. a lower bound. Excluding them raises the ratio to 1.182 (n=20), so the bias runs in favour of IC. The cell stays 'above' only barely.

The 'matched' rho is not a competent rho at these sizes. 96% of its Eops are table construction and trail starts (32 entries, two random scalar multiplications each, plus two per trail start), and its walk is only 66.7 group operations at k=16. The headline gap of 20.4x at k=16 is therefore a loose lower bound on the distance to a well-implemented rho (phase-only 476x). The report says this. The step exponent of 0.297 is another symptom of the same effect. Curve selection (even cofactor 2 <= h <= 16, l >= q/16) also shrinks l, and with it the rho cost, by up to a factor 4 relative to prime-order curves. Both effects go the same way: they make IC look better than it should, so the direction of the verdict is unaffected.

The report says 'Moving the instance into the Jacobian costs a rho nothing measurable'. That holds only under the generous kappa_J=1 convention. With the measured Jop/Eop field-cost ratio of 2.8 to 6.0, rho inside the Jacobian costs about 4x the field work of rho on E. R_J/R_E = 0.95 to 1.04 is a statement about operation counts, not field cost.

Two controls are weak. NC-B (target outside <G>) and NC-C (flipped v, so the answer is -x != x mod odd l) cannot pass by mathematical construction, so they only exclude a verifier that accepts everything. PC-C is the only control that tests whether the instrument can rank an IC arm as the winner, and it failed at w=1 for k=10 and 12.

No independent replication or adversarial review exists (no VERIFICATION.json). The reduced re-run is the same code with the same seed, so it checks determinism only. The numbers rest on the run agent's own work. My recomputation above is the only independent check.

Cost accounting is, if anything, lenient to IC: per-curve gluing setup (D7), the hash-map duplicate lookup per trial and the row-length cost of each row operation are unpriced. This does not change the verdict.
math.corrected_conclusion: The central finding holds. Under the frozen protocol, no genus-2 Jacobian index-calculus arm (IC-G, IC-S, IC-D) is cheaper than the negation-map rho on E at k=8..16. Point ratios are above 1 at every size and every native-work price. At w=0 the IC-D/R_E ratio rises from 1.127 to 20.414, and at w=1 from 2.805 to 149.993. Rho inside the transferred Jacobian is indistinguishable from rho on E in operation counts at kappa_J=1. I recomputed the headline numbers from the raw files and independently confirmed the construction on all 54 curves: #Jac = #E * #E', the C' L-polynomial is the product (x^2-tx+q)(x^2+tx+q), and l-parts are cyclic. The result should be labelled 'negative result, with several preregistered misses', not 'prediction_confirmed'. The 5a ranking should be scoped to raw counts and exponents, because PC-B misses at k=8 under the preregistered per-size reading, PC-C fails at k=10 and 12, and F2 flags the rho baseline as broken. The 'matched rho' is a table-dominated GP rho, so 20.4x is a loose lower bound on the real gap. 'The transfer costs rho nothing' holds only at kappa_J=1. No independent replication was done.

issues: The label prediction_confirmed contradicts the run's own record. Preregistered H4 (slope and point values), F2 (R_E steps slope 0.297, which the preregistration defines as 'baseline broken'), PC-C at k=10 and 12, PC-B at k=8, and NC-A/H5 all missed. The accurate status is 'F1 did not fire, but several preregistered predictions and controls failed'.

The matched-rho baseline is declared broken by the preregistration's own F2 rule. R_E steps scale with l, not q (post hoc explanation). The headline 'IC loses to matched rho' therefore rests on a baseline that failed its validity criterion. The post hoc explanation does not repair that under the preregistration.

R_E is 95.6-97.2% table construction at k>=9, so the rho cost is mostly a fixed setup term and the walk is a tiny share. The IC/R_E ratio growing from 1.1 to 20 is then driven by how the counted rho is composed at these sizes, not by an asymptotic gap. The phase-only ratio (6.3 to 476) differs from the headline by more than an order of magnitude, so the 'distance remaining' figure depends on the accounting choice.

The PC-C positive control failed at k=10 and 12 (w=1 IC-D/plain 0.997 [0.732,1.352] and 1.409 [1.062,1.836]). The pipeline therefore cannot show it ranks a genuine IC winner across the whole GAE band at those sizes. Under the preregistration the negative ranking carries no weight beyond raw counts and exponents. The claim 'all 27 IC cells rank above R_E by the 5a rule' should be treated as scoped to raw counts. PC-C does show IC-D beating plain rho at w=0 and 0.1.

PC-B rho verified-solve rates are 20/24 and 21/24 at k=8, below the >=0.95 criterion. F4 says a failed PC-B invalidates the instrument. Reporting the control as 'pooled 423/432' replaces the preregistered per-size criterion with a pooled one. Also 9 of 1080 solves are unverified.

The independent Haiku replication and the Sonnet adversarial verification (VERIFICATION.json) that the preregistration requires were not done. The same-code, same-seed rerun only checks determinism, not correctness or independence. Every result is single-run and unreplicated.

Code frozen at 20:20 was timestamped after the preregistration at 19:41. The deviations list shows the rho selector was changed (D2), the transfer formula was changed (D1) and elimination was altered (D4). These were preregistration departures made after the text was frozen, even though they predate the confirmatory run. They bear on how 'matched' R_J and the IC arms are.

Overreach. Sizes are only k=8..16 (q up to about 2^16) with 24 instances per size, so the log-log slopes (0.604, 0.958) and the 'no benefit at any price' claim cannot be extrapolated to cryptographic sizes. The H4 CI [0.579,0.628] shows the slope is near the band edge, so the slope is no clear evidence for or against a q^(1/2) gap growth. The post hoc diagnostics (NC-A pooled, phase-only ratio, steps vs sqrt(l/2)) are exploratory and should not support conclusions.

Wall times (1204 s main run) are contention-affected and secondary. They are correctly labelled and not used for ranking. The IC-G and IC-S cost ratios (41 and 176) depend on unpriced native work, which the 0/0.1/1 band does cover.
stats.corrected_conclusion: Narrow, defensible claim: in this frozen PARI/GP study at k=8..16, no Jacobian index-calculus arm beat the counted negation-map rho (F1 did not fire) at any price in the 0/0.1/1 GAE band, and rho inside the Jacobian is unresolved against rho in E. This is scoped to raw counts and exponents. It is not a confirmed prediction. H4, the F2 baseline-validity check, PC-B at k=8, PC-C at k=10 and 12, and NC-A all missed or failed. The F2 miss means the matched rho baseline failed its own validity criterion, and rho cost is about 96% table construction at these sizes, so the size of the ratio is accounting-dependent. The independent replication and adversarial review remain open. Nothing here supports a claim about larger sizes or an asymptotic gap.
